correctness.rationale: The projective gradient equations give exact dual support. GL5 discriminant covariance gives homogeneity degree 24 in ell and the smooth cubic surface dual has irreducible degree12, forcing its square. At smooth dual points the unique ordinary tangent plane node lifts to exactly two Hessian-nondegenerate A1 points swapped by u-sign. A generic Veronese conic meets the dual at 24 distinct smooth points. The incidence space is the blowup of smooth Y along smooth S. Supplementary exact SymPy witness verifies a concrete transverse conic but is not used as infinite proof.
